授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This class introduces students to the politics of history as a school subject in Asia - particularly in East Asia. Students may already be aware of controversies over the teaching of history in Japanese schools, but here we examine the Japanese case in comparative perspective. We look at how changes to the teaching of history, and arguments over how it should be taught, have been related to political conditions in societies throughout Asia, and beyond. One key aim in doing this is to enable students to look afresh at arguments over history education here in Japan, and see these in comparative perspective.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: history as a school subject, politics, Asia
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
Short lectures for each week's class will be recorded and uploaded onto Google Docs (or distributed via email) for students to listen to before class.
Each lecture will conclude with some questions or points for discussion. During the online classes, students will be expected to make comments and ask questions of their own - either directly, or using a text / 'chat' application.

障害(難病・慢性疾患含む)があり、通常の方法による授業を受けることが困難な場合には、教育目的の本質的な変更など過重な負担を伴わない限り、合理的配慮を受けることができます。合理的配慮とは、教授・学習法の変更、成績評価の方法の変更、授業情報の保障(資料の字幕化、個別の資料配布、録音・撮影の許可)、受講環境の調整などを指します。実際の方法については担当教員と建設的対話を行った上で決定されます。
